meta.name: Life Ledger — Private Anime Memory Archive
meta.description: A private single-user ledger whose product UI adapts the editorial composition, character imagery, motion language, and interaction metaphors of the anime sites stored in Pro UI.

primary.role: Chiramune-derived sky blue for active navigation, atmosphere, and primary data focus

secondary.role: Chiramune-derived orange for dates, warnings, and editorial punctuation

accent.role: Bocchi-derived hot pink for creation actions, ratings, and playful feedback

neutral.usage: White editorial rail and readable data surfaces over cool blue-black foundations

color.contrast_strategy: high-contrast ink on white, with saturated blue/pink image-led zones

font_families.heading: Cormorant Garamond, Noto Serif SC, Songti SC, serif
font_families.body: Jost, Noto Sans SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Kakekoi editorial serif for large titles; Jost-like geometric sans for controls; occasional vertical CJK title columns.

spacing.section_rhythm: Alternates immersive 55–72vh image-led sections with compact, highly legible data clusters

layout.grid_system: Fixed 284px editorial navigation rail plus fluid content canvas; asymmetric 5/7 and 4/8 content splits

shape.border_usage: hairline dark rules on white surfaces, plus occasional slanted clipping
shape.divider_style: thin ink rule with orange or pink editorial marker

elevation.depth_cues: overlapping character art, translucent panels, blur, and strong foreground/background scale changes

iconography.style: thin-line functional icons contained by square or circular anime-site controls

motion.entrance_pattern: clip-reveal or fade-up with small stagger; character art drifts from the opposite side

components.button_style: ink or hot-pink action blocks with an offset shadow and occasional diagonal corner
components.input_style: white translucent fields with a dark bottom rule, strong focus ring, and minimal radius
components.card_style: image-led editorial panels, chat bubbles, or white ruled sheets; avoid one universal rounded card
components.navigation_pattern: Kakekoi-derived fixed white title rail with thin list navigation
components.modal_style: Kakekoi-special-derived phone/chat panel over a blurred cool-blue scene
components.list_style: timeline spine with alternating accent markers and message-like content panels
components.component_notes: Privacy states remain unmistakable, but semantic colors are rendered as saturated anime-site labels rather than pastel SaaS badges.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A personal anime opening sequence crossed with a private message archive
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary Japanese anime promotional sites with print-editorial typography

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Large Kakekoi-like white fields surround compact data and create tension against full-bleed character scenes
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Fixed light rail on the left, immersive color and art on the right, with isolated hot accent controls
visual_language.texture_usage: subtle paper noise, bubbles, ink patterns, and soft photographic bloom

composition.flow_direction: left navigation rail to image field, then vertically down a timeline spine
composition.grouping_strategy: editorial rules, color punctuation, and deliberate overlap instead of repeated card containers
composition.negative_space_role: Creates privacy, calm, and a manga-panel pause between dense records

imagery.photo_treatment: cool bloom, soft contrast, selective dark overlays for text
imagery.illustration_style: real anime key visuals and line art from Pro UI sources
imagery.graphic_elements: bubbles, vertical kanji, offset labels, thin ruled lines, and diagonal corner cuts
imagery.pattern_usage: low-opacity Kakekoi ink/noise and Chiramune bubble particles
imagery.image_shape: full-bleed crops, tall character panels, and occasional slanted masks

interaction_feel.feedback_style: snappy color inversion with a small offset or scale response
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: art zooms slightly while labels slide and underline rules extend
interaction_feel.loading_style: short anime-title shutter rather than an indefinite skeleton

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: a quiet scene card with one clear next action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: plain, calm, and specific without breaking the visual world

overview.fallback_strategy: Disable drift, blur, and clip entrances under prefers-reduced-motion while preserving composition and contrast

background_effects.description: Cool sky gradients and character key visuals are layered with Kakekoi noise and subtle radial bloom

particle_systems.description: A small number of Chiramune bubble PNGs drift around selected hero and empty-state regions

params.movement_pattern: slow upward drift with lateral sway

3d_elements.description: No production 3D dependency; Emilia atmosphere is translated into 2D layers

shader_effects.description: The product does not carry the Emilia WebGL sequence into the authenticated data UI

parallax.layers: background art, translucent wash, foreground copy

scroll_morphing.description: Avoided to keep data navigation deterministic

text_effects.description: Display titles alternate ink, sky blue, orange, and pink while vertical side labels use a restrained fade

cursor_effects.description: Native cursor retained for accessibility and tool-like precision

image_effects.description: Hero and library art enters through vertical or diagonal clipping and gently scales on hover

canvas_drawings.description: Chiramune Canvas behavior is represented with lightweight CSS particles in the product shell

svg_animations.description: Icons use normal CSS transitions; no animated SVG dependency

visual_effects.composite_notes: The product preserves the source sites' composition and emotional cadence while all controls, labels, privacy states, and content are specialized for Life Ledger.
